Al abrir el juego mira si hay componente: When the game opens it checks for new components or new versions of them and tells you. It installs nothing unless you ask, unless you turn on the option below.
Al abrir el juego mira si hay una versió: When the game opens it checks for a new version and tells you. It downloads and installs nothing unless you ask, unless you turn on the option below.
Con sí, al abrir el juego se instalan so: With yes, when the game opens, new components or new versions of them install by themselves, without asking you, but only from the categories you ticked in Components, Categories you are interested in. If you do not want mods, none is installed. Check for new components at startup has to be on. With no, the default, it only tells you.
Con sí, cuando al abrir el juego encuent: With yes, when the game finds a new version on opening, it downloads it, checks it and installs it without asking you, as soon as you are in the main menu. It tells you before starting, and Escape cancels it. Check at startup has to be on. With no, the default, it only tells you.

Con la T y en los avisos del día. Con su: With T and in the notices of the day. With their name and number, the default; with the number only, as before; or with the name only. The game starts on a Monday, and places that close on some day, with opening hours turned on, close according to the day of the week.
Con sí, que es como viene, cuando cambia: With yes, the default, when you switch to another window the game stops speaking, so as not to interrupt your screen reader in whatever you are doing. Whatever happens meanwhile goes to the history: when you come back, you go over it with Page Up. Sounds keep playing. With no, it speaks even when you are in another window, as before.
Con sí, que es como viene, tus pasos sue: With yes, the default, your footsteps sound one a little to the left and the next a little to the right, like your two feet. With no, they all sound in the centre, in front of you. It works with both sound engines.
Deja todas las opciones como vienen con: Leaves every option as it comes with the game, after asking you. Your language, your servers and your network name are kept.
No, dejarlas como están: No, leave them as they are
Opciones restablecidas como vienen de se: Options reset to defaults. Your language, your servers and your network name are kept. Some changes, like the sound engine, take effect when you open the game again.
Todas las opciones vuelven a como vienen: Every option goes back to its default, including the keys and the volume of each sound. Your language, your saved servers, your network name and your artificial intelligence settings are kept. Your saved games are not touched.
